components.title: Button
components.description: Compact action hierarchy with loading-state geometry.
components.useWhen: The user needs to start or confirm a discrete action.
components.avoidWhen: Navigation is the intent. Use a link that can still look like a button.

components.title: Icon Button
components.description: Accessible square icon action with tooltip support.
components.useWhen: A familiar icon can represent a frequent action in a constrained area.
components.avoidWhen: The icon is ambiguous without explanation. Prefer a labelled Button.

components.title: Field & Fieldset
components.description: Accessible labels, guidance, validation, and grouped form semantics.
components.useWhen: A control needs a persistent label, supporting guidance, validation, or grouping semantics.
components.avoidWhen: The content is not form input or the label would only repeat nearby visible context.

components.title: Input Group
components.description: One text-entry boundary with contextual addons and compact actions.
components.useWhen: An addon or action belongs inside the same visual entry boundary as one text input.
components.avoidWhen: The adjacent controls perform unrelated work or several inputs form a compound value.
quality: Disabled and invalid state propagate to interactive children

components.title: Kbd
components.description: Presentational keyboard hints for keys, chords, and sequences.
components.useWhen: A visible hint explains a real keyboard shortcut or key sequence.
components.avoidWhen: The key is interactive on its own or no working shortcut exists.

components.title: Button Group
components.description: Related actions with shared rhythm and optional joined geometry.
components.useWhen: Two or more related actions benefit from shared alignment or joined geometry.
components.avoidWhen: Actions are unrelated, one action dominates an entire form, or arrow-key navigation is expected.
keyboard: Each button keeps ordinary Tab behavior
quality: Hierarchy remains visible without extra borders

components.title: Toolbar
components.description: Compact frequently used controls with roving keyboard navigation.
components.useWhen: A compact set of frequent peer controls benefits from one arrow-navigable region.
components.avoidWhen: Actions are infrequent, form submission is the main task, or controls need explanatory copy.

components.title: Text Field
components.description: Dense labelled input with hints, validation, and adornments.
components.useWhen: The user enters a short, unstructured value.
components.avoidWhen: A finite option set can be selected with less effort.
keyboard: Error is referenced by the input

components.title: Number Field
components.description: Locale-aware bounded numeric input with direct entry and step controls.
components.useWhen: The value is numeric and stepping, bounds, or locale-aware formatting reduce entry errors.
components.avoidWhen: The number is an identifier, phone number, postal code, or another string that is not mathematically stepped.
keyboard: Home and End reach bounds when supported
quality: Buttons keep a specific accessible name
Formatting never hides the raw submitted value

components.title: Segmented Control
components.description: Compact single selection between visible peer views or presentation modes.
components.useWhen: Two to four short peer options should remain visible and switch immediately.
components.avoidWhen: Options are numerous, require descriptions, or submit later as part of a form.

components.title: Calendar & Date Picker
components.description: Locale-aware date entry and calendar selection with shared validation.
components.useWhen: A date must be entered precisely while a calendar also makes nearby dates easier to inspect.
components.avoidWhen: The value is relative prose, a date range, or a full scheduling workflow with time zones and recurrence.
keyboard: Arrow keys edit segments or move dates
Page Up and Down move months
quality: Locale and calendar system are inherited
Typed and picked values stay synchronized
Unavailable dates remain legible and announced

components.title: Checkbox
components.useWhen: Several independent options may be selected together.
components.avoidWhen: A setting takes effect immediately. Use Switch for that case.

components.title: Switch
components.useWhen: Changing the setting should take effect immediately.
components.avoidWhen: The change must be reviewed and submitted with a form.

components.title: Tooltip
components.useWhen: A concise label clarifies an otherwise understandable control.
components.avoidWhen: The content is required to complete the task or contains actions.

components.title: Popover
components.useWhen: A small set of controls belongs next to its trigger.
components.avoidWhen: The task requires full attention, long forms, or a destructive decision.

components.title: Menu
components.useWhen: Related actions need a compact, temporary container.
components.avoidWhen: Options must remain visible for comparison or frequent access.

components.title: Dialog
components.useWhen: A short, reversible task needs focused attention and a clear completion point.
components.avoidWhen: The work can be completed inline, requires a long workflow, or demands an explicit consequential response. Use Alert Dialog for the latter.

components.title: Context Menu
components.description: Object-specific actions opened by right click, long press, or keyboard.
components.useWhen: A familiar object has secondary actions that benefit from right click or long press and also have a keyboard path.
components.avoidWhen: The action is required, frequent, undiscoverable without instruction, or the trigger has no stable object boundary.
keyboard: Shift + F10 or Context Menu key opens
quality: Trigger has a visible object boundary
Long press never blocks ordinary scrolling

components.title: Sheet
components.description: Edge-aligned focused panel with modal focus and spatial context.
components.useWhen: A focused task needs more room than a Popover but the originating page should remain spatially legible.
components.avoidWhen: The task is a short anchored choice, a full destination, or a gesture-driven drawer with snap points.
quality: Footer actions remain visible without obscuring content

components.title: Alert Dialog
components.description: Explicit modal response for consequential or irreversible actions.
components.useWhen: A consequential action must interrupt the task and requires an explicit response.
components.avoidWhen: The action is safely reversible with Undo or ordinary information is being displayed.
quality: Safe and destructive labels are specific

components.title: Tabs
components.useWhen: Peer views of the same object can switch without navigation.
components.avoidWhen: The sections form a sequence or users need to compare them simultaneously.

components.title: Toast
components.useWhen: The result is useful but should not block the current task.
components.avoidWhen: The user must act before continuing or the error belongs beside a field.
keyboard: Escape does not steal page focus

components.title: Inline Edit
components.description: In-place editing with save, cancel, blur, announcement, and focus restoration.
components.useWhen: A visible value is changed frequently and its location should remain stable.
components.avoidWhen: Validation is complex or several fields must be edited together.

components.title: Reorderable List
components.description: Pointer, touch, keyboard, and screen-reader reordering with visible drop intent.
components.useWhen: Users need to change a meaningful order and the new position can be previewed and reversed.
components.avoidWhen: Order is calculated, changes are destructive, or move up and down controls would be clearer for a tiny list.
quality: Pointer, touch, keyboard, and screen readers reach parity
Drop position is visible and announced
Order changes are controlled and reversible

components.title: Action List
components.description: Filterable keyboard-first action list with active-descendant focus.
components.useWhen: Many actions must be searched and executed without leaving keyboard flow.
components.avoidWhen: The list is ordinary navigation or needs persistent multi-selection.

components.title: Shared Detail
components.description: Object-preserving list-to-detail transition with focus return.
components.useWhen: Users need to inspect several neighboring objects without losing list context.
components.avoidWhen: The detail is a separate destination with deep navigation or a long workflow.

components.title: Undo Stack
components.description: LIFO reversible-action history with keyboard recovery and live announcements.
components.useWhen: A mutation can be reversed reliably without a confirmation dialog.
components.avoidWhen: The inverse action is unsafe, lossy, or impossible after submission.

components.title: Badge
components.description: Compact monochrome metadata and removable-filter labelling.
components.useWhen: A short label adds secondary classification or compact status context.
components.avoidWhen: The label triggers a primary action or contains a sentence.
keyboard: Remove action has a specific name

components.title: Avatar
components.description: Identity image, deterministic fallback, status, and grouping.
components.useWhen: Visual identity helps people recognize a person or entity faster than text alone.
components.avoidWhen: No identity exists or the image adds decoration without meaning.
keyboard: Fallback is ignored when adjacent text names identity

components.title: Textarea
components.description: Long-form input with guidance, validation, and character count.
components.useWhen: The user needs to enter more than one line of unstructured text.
components.avoidWhen: The value is short or highly structured. Use Text Field or a purpose-built selector.
quality: Resize never breaks the parent layout

components.title: Radio Group
components.description: Accessible mutually exclusive choices with descriptions and validation.
components.useWhen: A small set of mutually exclusive options should remain visible for comparison.
components.avoidWhen: The list is long or space is constrained. Use Select instead.
quality: Group and every item are labelled

components.title: Select
components.description: Short predefined selection with typeahead and collision handling.
components.useWhen: A compact control should choose one value from a short predefined list.
components.avoidWhen: The option set is large enough to require filtering. Use Combobox.
quality: Popup width and collision behavior are deliberate

components.title: Context Switcher
components.description: Rich single selection with icon, supporting copy, and layered flyout elevation.
components.useWhen: A short single-choice set changes the surrounding product context and each option needs an icon or one line of explanation.
components.avoidWhen: The value is an ordinary form field or the option set needs filtering. Use Select or Combobox instead.
keyboard: Arrow keys move the highlighted option
quality: Hover, focus, and selected remain distinct
Popup matches trigger width and keeps descriptions readable

components.title: Combobox
components.description: Filterable predefined selection with empty, clear, and disabled states.
components.useWhen: A predefined collection is large enough that filtering reduces selection effort.
components.avoidWhen: Free-form text should be accepted. Use Search Input or Text Field.

components.title: Search Input
components.description: Free-form native search with clear, loading, and shortcut affordances.
components.useWhen: The user enters a free-form query and results update or submit elsewhere.
components.avoidWhen: The value must come from a predefined set. Use Combobox.
keyboard: Escape may clear at product level
quality: Clear control appears only with a query

components.title: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Semantic location hierarchy with current-page and collapsed-depth handling.
components.useWhen: Users benefit from seeing and navigating the hierarchy above the current destination.
components.avoidWhen: The product is flat or the path duplicates a nearby persistent navigation tree.
keyboard: Current location is not an active link
quality: Deep paths collapse without losing endpoints

components.title: Pagination
components.description: Controlled, bounded, condensed page navigation.
components.useWhen: Users need stable page positions or direct access to a distant result page.
components.avoidWhen: Continuous browsing is the goal and an infinite list preserves context better.

components.title: Collapsible
components.description: Disclosure primitive for optional supporting content and advanced settings.
components.useWhen: Supporting content is useful on demand but should not compete with the primary task.
components.avoidWhen: The content is required, represents a destination, or several sections need accordion coordination.
quality: Reduced motion keeps the content change clear

components.title: Skeleton
components.description: Layout-preserving content placeholder geometry.
components.useWhen: The final layout is known and content is expected imminently.
components.avoidWhen: The layout is unknown, the wait is long, or progress can be quantified.

components.title: Progress
components.description: Determinate and indeterminate task progress with accessible status.
components.useWhen: A task duration is long enough that explicit completion feedback reduces uncertainty.
components.avoidWhen: The work is effectively immediate or progress cannot be meaningfully represented.
keyboard: Value is announced by progressbar semantics

components.title: Spinner
components.description: Compact labelled ongoing-work status.
components.useWhen: Ongoing work needs a compact indicator and progress cannot be quantified.
components.avoidWhen: The loading layout is large enough for a Skeleton or progress is measurable.

components.title: Alert
components.description: Persistent neutral or critical feedback with opt-in live announcement.
components.useWhen: Feedback should remain visible beside the affected work until it is understood or resolved.
components.avoidWhen: The message is transient, belongs to one field, or blocks progress until a response is chosen.
keyboard: Dismiss has a specific accessible name
quality: Announcement is opt-in rather than automatic

components.title: Empty State
components.description: Zero-result explanation with the smallest useful next action.
components.useWhen: A collection has no content and the reason or next useful action is not otherwise obvious.
components.avoidWhen: Content is still loading or the empty region is too small to justify explanatory UI.
keyboard: Only actions enter the tab order
quality: Offers the smallest useful next step
Never substitutes for a loading state

components.title: Table
components.description: Semantic tabular structure for product-specific sorting, filtering, and selection recipes.
components.useWhen: Rows share the same attributes and users need to scan or compare values across columns.
components.avoidWhen: Items are better understood as cards, the data is hierarchical, or responsive reading order cannot be preserved.
keyboard: Interactive controls use native tab order
quality: Data-table behavior is composed per product
Narrow layouts scroll without clipping cells

components.title: Data Table
components.description: Headless sorting, selection, visibility, ordering, pagination, and collection states over semantic table markup.

components.title: Filter Builder
components.description: Visible categorical query clauses with a compact add-and-remove workflow.

components.title: Data Toolbar
components.description: Saved views, query controls, and display settings in one labelled collection boundary.

components.title: Query Builder
components.description: A flat all-or-any condition builder with draft, apply, and cancel behavior.

components.title: Bulk Action Bar
components.description: Selection-scoped actions that appear without moving the collection.

components.title: Saved View Menu
components.description: Named system and personal collection states with explicit management actions.

components.title: Column Visibility Menu
components.description: Visible-column preferences with required-column protection.

components.title: Column Manager
components.description: Column visibility, order, pinning, and width reset with accessible named controls.

components.title: Editable Cell
components.description: Compact in-place editing with async save, cancel, validation, and focus restoration.

components.title: Facet Filter
components.description: Counted multi-selection for small enumerable data dimensions.

components.title: Data Sort Menu
components.description: One explicit sort field and direction for predictable collection order.

components.title: Data Group Menu
components.description: A single collection grouping dimension with an explicit clear path.

components.title: Data Density Control
components.description: Compact, default, and comfortable collection row rhythm.

components.title: Data Result Summary
components.description: Visible, filtered, and selected record counts in one semantic status line.

components.title: Cursor Pagination
components.description: Previous and next traversal for collections without a stable total page count.

components.title: Row Actions Menu
components.description: Object-specific actions behind a consistently placed compact control.

components.title: Property List
components.description: Dense semantic label-value metadata for inspectors and detail views.

components.title: Audit Log
components.description: Chronological product events with actors, targets, timestamps, and optional evidence.

components.title: Data State
components.description: Stable loading, empty, and error feedback for collection surfaces.

components.title: Data View State
components.description: Validated collection state, deterministic URL serialization, server request keys, and persistent personal views.

components.title: Data Export
components.description: Declared-column CSV and JSON export with safe filenames and spreadsheet formula neutralization.

components.title: Date Range Filter
components.description: Draft, preset, validate, and explicitly apply an open or bounded collection date range.

components.title: Data Export Menu
components.description: Export visible or selected records as CSV or JSON through one explicit collection action.

components.title: Data Export Progress
components.description: Background export progress with cancel, retry, completion, and download actions.

components.title: Tree
components.description: Hierarchical navigation and selection with expansion, typeahead, and roving focus.
components.useWhen: The hierarchy itself matters and users need to expand, collapse, navigate, or select nested items.
components.avoidWhen: The content is flat, several branches must be compared at once, or ordinary disclosure sections are sufficient.
keyboard: Arrow Up and Down move rows

components.title: Analytics Geometry
components.description: Dependency-free domain, tick, path, formatting, and text-summary utilities for whatiuse Analytics.

components.title: whatiuse Analytics Contract
components.description: Agent-readable component choice, state ownership, accessibility, and recipe contracts for analytic product surfaces.

components.title: whatiuse Product Patterns Contract
components.description: Agent-readable task, state ownership, failure, accessibility, and composition contracts for B2B product patterns.

components.title: Sparkline
components.description: A compact, non-interactive directional trace for an already-labelled metric.

components.title: Metric
components.description: One named value with restrained trend, comparison context, and stable loading geometry.

components.title: Chart
components.description: An interactive ordered-series chart with synchronized pointer and keyboard inspection plus a semantic data table.

components.title: Analytics Frame
components.description: Shared stable chart and semantic-table frame with loading, empty, error, and live inspection contracts.

components.title: Histogram
components.description: A pre-binned distribution with shared pointer and keyboard inspection plus an exact semantic table.

components.title: Scatter Chart
components.description: A two-measure point view with nearest-point inspection, keyboard parity, and source data.

components.title: Waterfall Chart
components.description: Sequential gains, losses, subtotals, and totals with a visible running-value contract.

components.title: Donut Chart
components.description: A small part-to-whole chart with shared pointer and keyboard inspection, visible shares, and a semantic table.

components.title: Radar Chart
components.description: A bounded multi-dimensional comparison with line-pattern redundancy and exact source values.

components.title: Gauge
components.description: One bounded measure with explicit minimum, maximum, current value, and optional target marker.

components.title: Sankey Chart
components.description: A compact directed-flow view with named nodes, inspectable links, and a semantic source table.

components.title: Heatmap
components.description: An interactive semantic matrix for repeated intensity patterns with explicit values and two-dimensional keyboard navigation.

components.title: Comparison
components.description: Current, previous, and relative change in one compact semantic definition list.

components.title: Breakdown
components.description: A ranked part-to-whole list with visible values and optional product selection.

components.title: Goal
components.description: Progress toward one explicit target with visible actual and target values.

components.title: Funnel
components.description: Ordered stage volume with explicit adjacent conversion and optional supporting-record selection.

components.title: Cohort
components.description: A keyboard-reachable semantic retention matrix with text in every heat cell.

components.title: Timeline
components.description: Dated product events that can control an analytic annotation without crowding the plot.

components.title: whatiuse Data
components.description: Three source-owned collection recipes for mutation, server data, and large immutable event streams.

components.title: whatiuse Analytics
components.description: Three source-owned product analytics recipes for revenue, usage, conversion, and retention decisions.

components.title: whatiuse Product Patterns
components.description: Three source-owned B2B product tasks for customer success, billing and usage, and member access.

components.title: whatiuse
components.description: The 45-component whatiuse Core plus source-owned Data, Analytics, and B2B Product Patterns, with reviewed light and dark themes.

recipes.title: Issues Workspace
recipes.intent: Triage, inspect, mutate, and recover issue work from one shared collection.
rules: Keep the collection visible while detail opens.
Use one selection source for table, detail, and bulk actions.
Route reversible mutations through Undo Stack.
forbidden: Do not replace the collection with a detail route.
Do not stack a new toast for each mutation.
Do not clear selection before recovery finishes.

recipes.title: Customer Directory
recipes.intent: Search, filter, save, share, and export a server-owned customer collection.
rules: Derive the URL and request key from the same validated state.
Keep column display state out of server requests.
Export only declared columns from an explicit scope.
forbidden: Do not re-sort server-owned rows in the browser.
Do not persist row selection.
Do not export hidden sensitive fields.

recipes.title: Audit Log
recipes.intent: Inspect a large immutable event stream with date bounds, virtualization, and safe export.
rules: Virtualize the final filtered row model.
Preserve semantic row count and indexes.
Keep event and time context available during horizontal scroll.
forbidden: Do not expose mutation or bulk actions.
Do not render every event at once.
Do not treat visual row position as record identity.

recipes.title: SaaS Overview
recipes.intent: Review recurring revenue, growth, targets, and expansion drivers in one period.
rules: Use one date range and metric definition across every value.
Keep current and previous periods comparable.
Keep a semantic data table with the chart.
forbidden: Do not show a trend without naming its period.
Do not encode direction with color alone.
Do not turn every metric into an unrelated card.

recipes.title: Usage & Adoption
recipes.intent: Filter accounts, compare usage and adoption, and follow activation into the supporting records.
rules: Keep transient chart inspection local.
Cross-filter only from explicit feature and stage selection.
Keep account detail and its source row on one stable id.
forbidden: Do not mirror hover state into account filters.
Do not hide exact account values behind the chart.
Do not animate high-frequency inspection.

recipes.title: Conversion & Retention
recipes.intent: Trace ordered conversion stages and compare retained behavior by cohort.
rules: Keep funnel stages strictly ordered.
Connect the selected stage to trend and supporting records.
Expose every cohort value as text.
forbidden: Do not use a funnel for independent categories.
Do not infer missing cohort values as zero.
Do not make color the only retention encoding.

recipes.title: Customer Workspace
recipes.intent: Find an account, inspect health and activity, and complete a follow-up without losing the list.
rules: Anchor detail to the selected customer row.
Use one customer record for health, owner, plan, and renewal context.
Return focus to the customer origin when detail closes.
forbidden: Do not reorder the list after a follow-up.
Do not encode health by tone alone.
Do not split account activity into an unrelated page.

recipes.title: Billing & Usage
recipes.intent: Compare plan, usage, limits, and invoices before changing a subscription.
rules: Use the same billing period across metrics, chart, limits, and invoices.
Keep exact consumed and allowed values visible.
Review a plan change before committing it.
forbidden: Do not change a plan from a transient menu action.
Do not hide payment risk behind color.
Do not lose the billing period when an invoice opens.

recipes.title: Members & Permissions
recipes.intent: Invite people, change roles, and audit access policy in one task.
rules: Show one role and invitation status per member.
Name the member in each role control.
Protect the last owner before a role mutation.
forbidden: Do not demote the last owner.
Do not apply a permission change to an ambiguous selection.
Do not reset filters when switching membership and role views.

when: The values are short and predefined.
A known option must be selected after search.
The selection changes the surrounding product context.
rejectWhen: The value is an ordinary form field.

when: The anchored action set is short.
rejectWhen: Actions need search or cross-product discovery.

when: The workflow is keyboard-first and the action set is large.
rejectWhen: The set is a small anchored menu.

selectionRules.task: Keep compact controls beside an origin
when: The controls are optional and contextual.
rejectWhen: The content is only a label.

when: The task needs temporary focused attention and can be cancelled.
The decision is consequential and lacks a safe inverse.
rejectWhen: Undo can reliably recover the action.

when: The message is brief and does not require a response.
rejectWhen: The user must choose what happens next.

when: A reliable inverse exists.
rejectWhen: The inverse is lossy or unsafe.

selectionRules.task: Inspect one item without losing place
when: The source collection remains useful during inspection.
rejectWhen: The detail is a long independent task.

selectionRules.task: Compare and operate on a collection
when: Sort, filter, select, resize, pin, or virtualize serves the task.
rejectWhen: The content is short and static.

when: A stable target and actual value are both known.
rejectWhen: The work is an indeterminate process.

when: Exact values, comparison, and point inspection matter.
Continuous or bucketed values need shape, spread, and outlier inspection.
rejectWhen: The x-axis is an ordered time series.

selectionRules.task: Inspect a relationship between two measures
when: Both axes are continuous and correlation, clusters, or outliers matter.
Ordered positive and negative contributions reconcile a known start and end.
rejectWhen: The sequence does not reconcile to a meaningful total.

when: A small set of normalized dimensions forms a meaningful profile.
rejectWhen: Scales are not comparable or there are too many axes.

when: A single current value has an explicit minimum, maximum, and concise status meaning.
rejectWhen: The value is an indeterminate process.

when: Named sources, destinations, and weighted transfers form a small acyclic network.
rejectWhen: The flow is a single ordered conversion path.
The graph is cyclic, dense, or needs general node editing.

forbiddenRules: Do not invent undocumented props, exports, registry items, or private CSS selectors.
Do not merge components because their closed shapes look similar; preserve task, focus, and recovery boundaries.
Do not add a primitive when an existing recipe already owns the product task.
Do not persist selection, open overlays, pointer position, loading state, or in-flight work.
Do not place column sizing, pinning, or visual tooltip state in server requests.
Do not use a Toast when the user must respond or when status must remain visible.
Do not use Alert Dialog when a reliable Undo path exists.
Do not hide exact values behind color, charts, progress fills, or iconography.
Do not remove semantic tables or text summaries from analytic visuals.
Do not animate high-frequency inspection, keyboard navigation, sorting, filtering, or virtual scrolling.
Do not move focus on pointer activation; reserve visible focus treatment for keyboard navigation.
Do not change collection geometry when detail, selection, bulk actions, loading, or feedback appears.
Do not create a new feedback stack for sequential outcomes; update one foreground feedback identity.
Do not claim production adoption, external review, or device coverage without evidence.
